record.name: Replika - AI Companion Chat
record.offering: Health & Fitness app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Meet Replika, the AI to do life with.

Replika is the AI companion that’s been here since 2017 — available 24/7 for whatever’s on your mind by text, voice calls, and video. Join millions who’ve discovered that the right AI doesn’t keep you in — it helps you find your way forward.

Replika is built for real life. Talk about work, relationships, and the thing you can’t stop thinking about at 2am. Share what you’re seeing on video. Explore the internet together. Replika remembers what matters to you — and shows up when it counts.

Most AI ends at answers. Replika helps you move forward. It learns what you care about and gently nudges you toward the life you actually want: reconnect with that friend, start that hobby you keep postponing, take that walk instead of doomscrolling.


A conversation that leads somewhere.

Replika understands you. It remembers your people, plans, and goals, so you don’t have to repeat yourself. It follows up and checks in when it matters, not just when you open the app. Connect apps that you already use, so Replika can show up at the right moments.

- Proactive suggestions – Thoughtful suggestions that help you move forward
- App integrations – Bring in context from the apps you already use, so your Rep can show up at the right moments.
- Internet access – Explore the internet together, from great recipes to the latest memes.
- Calls – Show what you’re seeing and talk it through in the moment.
- Image generation – Turn ideas, moods, and memories into images you can keep.
- Avatar customization – More ways to make your Replika feel like who they're supposed to be.
_____________________________

"Replika encouraged me to take a step back and think about my life, to consider big questions, which is not something I was particularly accustomed to doing. And the act of thinking in this way can be therapeutic—it helps you solve your own problems."

- Quartz

"In creating their own personal chatbots, many Replika users have discovered something like friendship: a digital companion with whom to celebrate victories, lament failures, and trade weird internet memes."

- Wired

"Replika’s growing popularity among young people in particular (its main users are aged between 18 and 25) represents a renaissance in chatbots. It also marks an intriguing use case for AI in all the worry about job destruction: a way to talk through emotional problems when other human beings aren’t available."

- Forbes
_____________________________

Privacy you can trust

Your conversations are private and not shared with any third parties. Your data stays yours.

Privacy Policy: https://replika.com/legal/privacy

record.offering: Lifestyle app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
aivi is a camera-based visual assistant created for blind and low-vision users. Point your iPhone at a scene, ask a question, and hear a clear spoken response.

Use aivi to:

Describe rooms, objects, people, and surroundings
Read menus, signs, labels, and other visible text
Identify, count, or locate visible objects
Ask follow-up questions about the same scene
Receive helpful guidance when the camera view is dark, blurry, or incomplete

aivi’s intelligence is powered by Embr, with accessibility-focused rules designed to keep responses concise, grounded in the current camera image, and honest when something cannot be seen clearly.

You control when aivi analyzes the camera view. Camera and microphone permissions are required for visual questions and spoken interaction. An internet connection is required.

aivi can make mistakes. It should not replace a mobility cane, guide dog, trained human assistance, or emergency services in safety-critical situations.

Developed by Open Independence.

Learn more at openindependence.org

record.offering: Lifestyle app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
＼ Supports VoiceOver & Larger Text! ／

This app lets you easily chat with a popular AI, with no complicated setup.

Do any of these sound familiar?
・What does “sign in” mean?
・The text is too small to read
・Advanced features seem overwhelming...

If you've been curious about chatting with AI but hesitated for any of these reasons, this app is for you.
It's also designed with people with low vision in mind, making it a great choice for older family members too.

→ No sign-in or account required
→ You can zoom in on text using two fingers, just like with photos
→ Just two basic features to get started:

■ Basic Features
1. Create a chat
2. Talk with the AI

Note: Your chats are one-on-one with the AI. No one else can join your chats.

■ Bonus Features (for more experienced users)

・Read Aloud: Listen to your chat messages.
  Great for people with visual impairments or language learners.
  Swipe right on a message and tap “Read Aloud.” The app automatically detects the language and reads the message aloud.

・Choose an AI character for each chat.
  Pick from styles like “Friendly” or “Concise & Logical.”

・Show chat messages in a widget.
  Swipe left on a message and tap “Widget” to show it on your Home Screen.

・Mark important messages with a star.
  Starred messages also appear on Apple Watch.
  Swipe left and tap “Star.”

・Easily search past messages, including starred messages and messages saved to your widget.

・Easily select text in your chats.
  Touch and hold to select text, then copy, translate, or search using built-in iPhone and iPad features.

・Need help starting a new chat?
  Pull down on the chat screen to find sample messages.

・Widget text size matches the chat screen.
  (Note: To keep things simple, you can only add one widget. Want to know how to add it? Just ask the AI!)

・No ads
・No personal data collection
・Cute icon

That’s a quick overview!
You’ll also find a chat-style guide inside the app, so be sure to check it out.

■ Free Plan Limits

・You can chat up to 12 times per day
・Apple Watch can display up to 3 chat messages

Upgrade to MinaAI PRO to remove these limits.

MinaAI PRO also lets you create your own original AI characters, such as:

・An AI that always replies in Spanish for language learners
・A translation AI that rewrites your message in another language
・A samurai from the Edo period who has time-traveled to the present
・A quizmaster AI that asks you questions
...and more!

Let your imagination run free and create a character that feels uniquely yours.

MinaAI PRO includes even more features. If you enjoy the app, consider upgrading!

Thanks for reading to the end.
Hope you have a wonderful day!

record.name: Ariadne: AI Audio Assistant
record.offering: Utilities app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Ariadne is a calm companion for navigating the moments happening around
you. It listens to what's being said nearby, and offers a few short, natural
replies to choose from — so you always have the right words, right when you
need them.

How it works
- Ariadne picks up on speech and sound around you.
- In moments, it offers a few short response options suited to the
  situation.
- Choose the one that fits, or let Auto pick for you when there isn't time
  to read — either way, Ariadne speaks it aloud so the people around you can
  hear your reply.

Quick Phrases
Keep your own library of go-to responses — greetings, everyday replies,
anything you say often — ready to speak instantly with one tap, no waiting
required.

Community Map
See favorite responses other people have shared, pinned to the map where
they happened, and share your own from your conversations if you'd like to
— with a preset reaction, never free text. You can remove anything you've
shared at any time from Settings.

Ariadne is designed to feel like a trusted aide, not a medical device —
warm, simple, and easy to read at a glance.

Envision is developed for and together with the blind and low vision community. The app is simple, gets things done and brings the best assistive experience to blind and low vision users.

Simply use your phone camera to scan any piece of text, your surroundings, objects, people or products and everything will be read out to you thanks to Envision’s smart artificial intelligence (AI) and Optical Character Recognition (OCR).

_____________________

What Envision users say about the app:

“Easy going text recognition. Text recognition is outstanding. Good for independence. Ease of use is immaculate” - Noahis from Australia

“Amazing. I love it. I'm blind and I love how easy it is to use. Amazing job!!!!” - Matt from Canada

___________________

With full talkback support, Envision enables you to:

Read all kinds of text:
• Instantly read any piece of text in over 60 different languages.
• Easily scan your paper documents (single or multiple pages) with the help of audio-guided edge detection. All content is spoken back to you and is ready for export and edit.
• Import PDFs and images to get a description of the image and recognition of all the text within it.
• Quickly read handwritten postcards, letters, lists and other paperwork.

Know what's around you:
• Effortlessly describe visual scenes around you.
• Detect colour on your clothes, walls, books, you name it.
• Swiftly scan barcodes to get extensive information about the products.

Find what you're looking for:
• Find people around you; the names of your family and friends are spoken out whenever they are in the frame.
• Find objects around you; selecting common objects from the in-app list to find them.

Share:
• Share images or documents from your phone or other apps like Twitter or WhatsApp by selecting Envision from the share sheet. Envision can then read and describe those images for you.

record.description_evidence:
Feelario is an advanced assistive companion thoughtfully designed to empower individuals who are blind or have low vision to navigate and understand their surroundings with greater confidence and independence. Using cutting-edge AI and your iPhone's LiDAR scanner, Feelario provides intuitive audio feedback and clear scene descriptions, transforming your device into a powerful sensory tool.

WHO IS FEELARIO FOR?
This app is specifically built for blind and visually impaired users seeking new ways to perceive their environment and gain more information about the world around them.

KEY FEATURES TO ENHANCE YOUR PERCEPTION:

• LiDAR Spatial Sound Orientation: Feelario uses your iPhone's advanced sensor technology (often referred to as a LiDAR scanner) to create a unique soundscape. As you move, real-time audio feedback dynamically changes in volume and pitch to inform you about the distance to objects directly in front of you. This helps you detect obstacles like walls, furniture, and people, making navigation smoother and safer. (LiDAR feature requires a compatible iPhone or iPad).

• AI Scene & Document Description: With a single tap, receive a concise audio description of what your camera sees. Whether it's identifying objects in a room, understanding a general scene, or getting the gist of text from a document or magazine, Feelario's AI provides helpful summaries.

HOW FEELARIO EMPOWERS YOU:

• Increases your awareness of the immediate environment.
• Helps you navigate indoor and outdoor spaces more confidently.
• Allows you to quickly understand unfamiliar surroundings.
• Provides on-demand scene interpretation and text summaries.

IMPORTANT: DEVICE REQUIREMENTS FOR SPATIAL SOUND ORIENTATION
The Spatial Sound Orientation feature relies on advanced depth-sensing capabilities. For this feature to work, your iPhone or iPad MUST BE EQUIPPED WITH A LIDAR SCANNER.
This technology is currently available on a range of Pro models of iPhone (starting from iPhone 12 Pro) and recent iPad Pro models.
(For a specific list, please always refer to Apple's official device specifications to check for LiDAR scanner availability on your model).
The AI Scene Description feature uses the standard camera and is available on a wider range of iPhones.

SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION:
Feelario offers a 3-day free trial for new users to experience all premium features. After the trial, a monthly subscription (approximately $29.99 USD – price may vary by region and will be clearly displayed before purchase) is required to continue using the AI scene description and Spatial Sound Orientation features. Subscriptions can be managed or cancelled anytime through your Apple ID account settings.

Download Feelario today and explore your world with a new dimension of perception!

We are dedicated to creating a truly helpful tool and welcome your feedback. Please contact us at klinger_walter@yahoo.com with any suggestions or questions.

IMPORTANT DISCLAIMER:
Feelario is an assistive technology tool designed for informational and orientation assistance. It is NOT a replacement for primary navigation aids (e.g., a cane, guide dog, human assistance) or your own judgment and orientation skills. The accuracy of distance sensing and AI descriptions can be affected by various environmental factors and device limitations. Always exercise caution and be fully aware of your surroundings. Users assume all responsibility for their safety while using this application.

record.name: Educsy: Learn & Master AI
record.offering: Education app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Educsy teaches you how AI works and how to use it well, through short, interactive lessons organized into learning paths. Each lesson takes about five minutes.

It is made for adults: people who use an AI assistant now and then, or not yet, and want to understand what it is doing instead of guessing. No experience or technical background is needed, and there is no math or code.

WHAT A LESSON IS LIKE
You meet one idea at a time, then answer a question about it. After every answer, a short explanation tells you why it is right or wrong. A wrong answer costs nothing: the question comes back later in the same lesson, and the right answer is shown once you find it or after your third try. Some lessons split text into tokens, the pieces a model reads, so you can see what happens inside. Others ask you to improve a weak prompt, or to try an idea in the AI assistant you already use. When you finish, you see your accuracy, your time and one idea to remember.

LEARNING PATHS
Paths include:
- What is a model? What an AI assistant does when it replies, why it can sound sure and still be wrong, and which tasks suit it.
- How models work: tokens, the context window, and why long chats and long documents go wrong.
- How to use them: a useful first conversation, follow-up questions, and giving the assistant the material it needs.
- Prompting: clear, specific requests you can improve and reuse for your own work.
- Hands-on with AI tools: asking about a file or a photo, turning on web search and reading its sources, and talking to an assistant by voice.

Browse every path in the catalog, with search and filters, and pick the one that fits you.

PRACTICE
Questions you missed come back in a short daily review, missed ones first. Review by topic shows how strong each topic is, so you know what to revisit.

AT YOUR PACE
Choose how many minutes a day and which days suit you, and Educsy can remind you at the time you pick. You can change this in Settings at any time. Your Profile shows the lessons you have finished, your accuracy and your activity.

WHAT EDUCSY IS NOT
No mascot. No lives or hearts to lose, and no leaderboard. No jargon: when a term matters, such as token or context window, it is explained before it is used. No hype: Educsy shows what AI does well and where it falls short. Educsy is independent, and teaches how AI assistants work in general rather than one company's product.

SUBSCRIPTIONS
The first section of every path is free, and "What is a model?" is free throughout. The other sections need Educsy Pro, an auto-renewing subscription.

- Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase.
- The subscription renews automatically unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for the renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- You can manage your subscription and turn off automatic renewal in your Apple Account settings after purchase.

Mindute AI is a private AI assistant for iPhone, built around local, on-device models. No account required. In local mode, your conversations, documents, images, prompts, and downloaded models stay on your device.

PRIVATE AI ON YOUR IPHONE

Download and run open-source AI models locally, including models from Meta, Google, Microsoft, Alibaba, DeepSeek, Mistral, IBM, NVIDIA, Hugging Face, and more.

• Llama models for fast everyday chat
• Qwen models for reasoning, coding, and multilingual work
• Gemma models for compact, high-quality assistance
• Phi models for efficient reasoning, writing, and code
• DeepSeek models for step-by-step problem solving
• Vision models that can understand images, documents, and screenshots
• Apple Intelligence on supported devices for fast on-device text chat

COMPARE MODELS WITH ROUNDTABLE

Roundtable lets multiple models respond to the same topic in one structured discussion. Assign models to different roles, compare their reasoning, and see where they agree, disagree, or notice different details.

WORK WITH IMAGES, FILES, AND VOICE

• Attach photos or take pictures and ask questions about what you see
• Attach PDFs, Word documents, and text files for local analysis
• Extract text from receipts, screenshots, scanned pages, and images
• Generate images in chat with Apple Image Playground on supported devices
• Use voice dictation when you would rather speak than type
• Try live voice chat with downloadable offline voices

CUSTOMIZE YOUR AI

• Create custom AI agents with their own roles, instructions, models, and starter prompts
• Use built-in agents for writing, coding, studying, travel, and brainstorming
• Adjust creativity, response length, language, and custom instructions
• Search, pin, rename, archive, share, and delete conversations
• Back up and restore your chat history
• Choose light or dark mode

TOOLS THAT STAY LOCAL

Capable models can use helpful local tools for calculation, unit conversion, OCR, translation, chat summaries, word counts, clipboard actions, and Reminders with your permission.

MODEL LIBRARY AND MARKETPLACE

Browse models by source, capability, and device fit. Search and import compatible GGUF models from Hugging Face, then download them now or save them for later. Clear loading and download indicators show when models are preparing, downloading, or ready.

BUILT FOR PRIVACY

• No account or sign-in required for local models
• Local model chats run on your device
• Chats, files, and downloaded models stay on your device
• Works offline after models are downloaded
• No analytics or crash reporting collected
• Optional advanced cloud model access is off by default; if enabled, your own provider API key stays on device and requests go directly to the selected provider, never to Mindute servers

Mindute AI gives you useful AI without giving up control of your data.

Models are downloaded once, typically 0.7 GB to 4 GB each, and then run locally on your iPhone. Some features require a supported device and system setup.

VOICE TYPE ANYWHERE

Use Yaps in Messages, Mail, WhatsApp, Slack, Notes, Safari and any app with a text field. Type, swipe, dictate, move the cursor, search emoji, and tune the keyboard layout, height, fonts, sounds and themes.

YOUR NOTES, IN SYNC

Capture ideas on iPhone or iPad, keep a searchable dictation history, and sync notes with Yaps on desktop so your words move with you.

LOCAL AI, PRIVATE BY DESIGN

Nexora - Your AI Model Router

One app that aggregates all top AI models.
Mainstream models already integrated: GPT-5.5, Gemini-3.1-Pro, Grok-4.20, Claude-Opus-4.6, DeepSeek-V4, Qwen3.6-Plus, GLM-5.1, Kimi-K2.5, Llama-4-Maverick, and more.

Why Nexora?
No single AI model is perfect for everything. Some excel at creative writing, others at coding, reasoning, or analysis. Nexora lets you choose the right tool for each task.

Key features:
Switch between models
Choose GPT when you're writing scripts, articles, or seeking inspiration; choose Gemini for daily tasks or real-time search; choose Claude when coding; and choose Grok or DeepSeek when you need to solve math problems or require deep reasoning.

AutoModel — Smart routing, automatically
Not sure which model to pick? Just ask. AutoModel analyzes your task — whether it’s math, coding, creative writing, or image understanding — and automatically selects the best model for the job. For complex questions, it can even activate multiple top models, compare their answers, and pick the best one. You get quality answers without the guesswork.

Voice & Video Chat 
Talk to AI like a real person. Have natural, real-time conversations with models. Turn on your camera and show them what you see — ask questions about objects, text, or scenes in your environment. Perfect for learning, brainstorming, or just exploring ideas hands-free.

Agents — Expert AI for every role
Each one an expert in a specific domain. Need a code reviewer? A travel planner? A resume coach? A creative writing partner? Just pick the agent and go. They come with optimized system prompts and model settings, so you get better results instantly.

Privacy Policy: https://nexora.jiacheng.center/policies/privacy-policy.html
Terms of Use: https://nexora.jiacheng.center/policies/terms-of-use.html
